method.rubric: Frozen route criteria from questions.json, applied only to frozen issue titles, bodies, and empty comment arrays in cases.json.
method.deterministic_lint: Preserved factory/triage.py behavior: body under 80 characters, or body/comments lacking an acceptance hint and a fenced code block, routes to needs-info before model judgment.
method.interpretation: These are source-grounded provisional assessments for comparison, not accuracy labels, human adjudication, or claims about later issue outcomes. Explicit blockers are treated as execution prerequisites rather than missing specification unless the body also leaves required information or approval unresolved. Read-only implementation around authority evidence is distinguished from granting or changing authority.
